title: b7z9.36(b): Rust — capability-announce dispatch + capability table in lichen-gateway
description: Child of b7z9.36. Mirror the Python (a) resource in rust lichen-gateway: POST /.well-known/capability-announce in the gateway dispatch, bounded LRU capability table (256, 25% egress reservation), COSE_Sign1 decode + Schnorr48 verification mirroring python verify_capability_announcement ordering (reserved bits, IID match, signature, expiry, seq replay). Tests mirroring the python cases.
